svg.text: Solid boxes exist today; dashed boxes are planned. Agents act only through Pipit's tools; statistics decide where cases go; code grades; registered rules decide.

Configuration flows down: a machine profile (memory, engines, stream caps, budgets) → a study file (roles, tolerance, budgets, team size) → model manifests → command-line overrides. Keys stay in the environment.
